blogs.title: From LSTM to xLSTM: Why Reviving Recurrent Networks Matters for Today's Large Language Models
blogs.description: A beginner-friendly overview of the original LSTM architecture, its historical impact, and the motivations behind extending it into xLSTM. The post explains the three key limitations of classic LSTMs—irreversible storage, limited memory capacity, and lack of parallelism—and sets the stage for how xLSTM aims to solve them.

blogs.title: Exponential Gating Explained: How xLSTM Learns to Forget and Remember Better
blogs.description: A deep dive into the new exponential gating mechanism introduced in xLSTM. The article breaks down the math in plain language, shows why replacing sigmoid gates with exponential ones improves revision of stored information, and illustrates the concept with visual examples like the nearest‑neighbor search task.

blogs.title: Memory Matters: Scalar vs. Matrix Memories in sLSTM and mLSTM
blogs.description: An accessible comparison of the two memory structures proposed in xLSTM—scalar memory (sLSTM) and matrix memory (mLSTM). Readers will learn how matrix memories act like fast‑weight associative memories, why they boost rare‑token prediction, and what trade‑offs exist between capacity and computational cost.

blogs.title: Building xLSTM Blocks: Residual Connections, Up‑Projection, and Scaling to Billions of Parameters
blogs.description: A step‑by‑step guide to assembling xLSTM blocks, explaining residual stacking, pre‑ vs. post‑up‑projection strategies, and how these design choices enable linear‑time training while preserving the expressive power of deep recurrent networks.

blogs.title: Benchmarks & Beyond: How xLSTM Stacks Up Against Transformers, SSMs, and Modern RNNs
blogs.description: A summary of the extensive experiments from the paper—synthetic formal language tasks, associative recall, Long‑Range Arena, and large‑scale language modeling. The post translates perplexity numbers and scaling‑law plots into easy-to‑understand takeaways for practitioners deciding which architecture to try next.

blogs.title: Practical Tips for Training xLSTM Models on Real Data
blogs.description: A hands‑on post that gathers all the engineering insights from the paper’s “Limitations” section: CUDA kernel considerations, gate initialization tricks, handling matrix memory size, mixed‑precision pitfalls, and recommendations for hyperparameter tuning when scaling beyond 1 B parameters.
